gholam.text:
ببین رفیق، جیکوب کاکسون که قبلاً تو انتروپیک کار می‌کرده، پشت پرده این غول هوش مصنوعی رو رو کرده و گفته کارمندهای اونجا خودشون رو مثل «مورچه» می‌بینن و قید کارای پرزرق‌وبرق و رزومه‌ساز رو می‌زنن تا فقط شرکت رو زودتر به ابرهوش مصنوعی برسونن. طرف میگه اوپن‌ای‌آی حسابی شلخته و بی‌تمرکزه و با پروژه‌های فانتزی مثل ابزار ویدیویی سورا یا ساخت گجت وقت تلف می‌کنه، در حالی که توی انتروپیک اگه کاری مستقیم به خط مقدم ابرهوش نخوره، هر هفت تا هم‌بنیان‌گذار جلوش وایمیستن و درجا دمش رو قیچی می‌کنن. خلاصه این بچه‌ها مثل کارگرای یه لونه مورچه، از خودشون و منافع فردی‌شون مایه گذاشتن تا توی این مسیر فقط رو یه مأموریت قفل بمونن.

چرا مهمه؟ اهمیتش اینه که نشون میده تو جنگ رسیدن به قله هوش مصنوعی، انتروپیک داره با تمرکز فولادی و چراغ‌خاموش جلو میره و رقیبش اوپن‌ای‌آی رو یه سیستم نامنظم و پراکنده می‌دونه.

links.text:
Jacob Coxon says Anthropic employees call themselves “ants” and sacrifice their careers for the company’s singular pursuit of superintelligence, while calling OpenAI "distracted and messy"

“At Anthropic, it felt a lot more like—well, for starters, the employees call themselves ants. They’re ants in the anthill. Everyone is like a worker ant trying to make Anthropic’s mission go well.

“People are very willing to sacrifice themselves for the good of the mission. They’ll take on work that’s less interesting, less big, bold and exciting, and less flashy. They’ll do it at a hit to their own interests for the good of the company.

“That’s because every decision comes back down to, ‘Is this going to get us to superintelligence faster?’

“You’ve seen Sora, the video platform OpenAI made. Anthropic would never make Sora because it’s not on the core path to artificial superintelligence. OpenAI is distracted and messy. One guy says, ‘I want to do Sora,’ or, ‘I want to build a little device,’ and they let them do it because it doesn’t have the same focus. At Anthropic, that would never happen.”

Patrick Bet-David: “Who would shut it down? The seven co-founders?”

Jacob Coxon: “They’d all agree. It would be like, ‘This video isn’t the right direction for heading straight to superintelligence.’”

quote.text:
Ex-Anthropic Jacob Coxon says he's 90% certain China already has spies inside both OpenAI and Anthropic

Jacob Coxon: “Right now, if we just stopped, they would try and catch up. But I think one really important thing people don’t realize is that China already has spies at OpenAI and Anthropic. China has the ability to hack at any time. If we pull ahead, that doesn’t give us a big lead. They can just step in, steal our progress at any time and catch up.”

Patrick Bet-David: “How certain are you that they already have spies there?”

Jacob Coxon: “Ninety percent. Yeah, it’s almost certain that they have spies.”
